item.title: Version 1.9.17
item.description:
A popover that holds its shape

  • Long holding lists stay inside the popover. With many positions across your portfolios, the per-symbol list used to grow past the popover, pushing the tabs off the top and the portfolio list and Import/Export off the bottom. It now scrolls within its own area, and everything else stays in reach.
  • Short lists take only the room they need. With a handful of symbols the panel shrinks to its content instead of leaving an empty gap.
